scene.heading: HOW THE BOOKS COUNT A NEW STORE

more.text: MORE NEW STORES = MORE SLICES, EVERY YEAR

say: Why does that matter? A new store costs a lot to build. But the company's books do not count that cost in one go. They spread it over many years, one slice every year, like a shopkeeper counting a new delivery van as it wears out. So every new store adds a slice to every future year.
